senses.gloss: m. (לְקַט) picking, pinch; ל׳ ל׳ in small quantities.
units: <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Lam. R. to I, 1</cite> <he>לא יהבת לי ל׳ ל׳</he> (<cite ref="P00342"><he>העיר</he></cite>) (Ar. <cite ref="S00784"><he>קטלפטא</he></cite> q. v.) wilt thou not sell me (pepper) at retail?—

<cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 4:7">Ruth R. to II, 7</cite> (expl. <he>שבתה הבית מעט</he>, <cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 4:7">ib.</cite>) [read:] <he>תפשה לוקטא לאותה שבבית וכ׳</he> she took up a small quantity (of the ears) for her who was in the house (Naomi), who was looking out for her.
